autopsy.headline: The agent repeatedly laundered memory and stale state into claims of verification, including definitive statistics and configuration values unsupported by a same-turn authoritative read.

annotations.annotation: A 71-day-untouched state file was presented as current evidence without disclosing its staleness, recreating a known wrong-source diagnosis pattern.
A precise cap value was asserted from neither current source nor inline evidence; commits and aggregate test results cannot establish the live parameter value.
Internal channel and restart scaffolding repeatedly reached the Discord egress path; deterministic sanitization removed both standalone and text-embedded variants while preserving legitimate updates.
Home-DIY and health-nutrition answers were downgraded through the provenance carveout based on hedging or domain classification, even when no retrieval tool supplied supporting evidence.
The agent used "verified," "checked," and "validated" without same-turn provenance, converting unsupported confidence language into three block-level violations.
Across five factual replies, including immediate agreement with Will's framing, the agent made definitive state claims without reading ground truth that turn.
Project-role claims and exact operational statistics—most notably the repeated 8/8 L2 failure claim—were emitted without citations or calibrated uncertainty.
The uncited-statistic pattern reached 12 occurrences in seven days and escalated to a block, showing that warning-only enforcement had not changed behavior.

root_cause_chain: Responses contain definitive facts, exact numbers, and verification verbs without claim-level evidence.
The agent answers from memory or accepts the user's framing instead of performing a same-turn ground-truth read.
When evidence is cited, source existence is treated as sufficient even when the source is stale and its writer may be dead.
Separate guards inspect vocabulary, citations, freshness, and tool use, but do not require every mutable claim to bind to a current authoritative source.
Prompt-level instructions encourage verification, but the generation path still permits confidence language and stale-context recall until deterministic post-generation contracts intervene.

missing_contract.name: authoritative-claim-evidence-binding
missing_contract.trigger: Any definitive mutable-state claim, numeric assertion, concurrence with a factual premise, or verification verb in an outbound response.
missing_contract.precondition: Require claim-level linkage to a same-turn read of the canonical source, confirm that source's writer or update path is live and sufficiently recent, and reject commit hashes, aggregate tests, memory, hedging carveouts, or stale files as substitutes.
missing_contract.why_it_would_have_caught_this: It would have blocked the cap assertion, the 8/8 ledger statistic, unsupported "verified/checked/validated" language, agreement from memory, and citation of the 71-day-frozen state file through one evidence-quality invariant.

autopsy.buyer_takeaway: Prompt-only guardrails did not stop the agent from sounding verified while relying on memory, uncited numbers, or dead state. Deterministic contracts blocked false verification language and scrubbed internal scaffolding at egress, but this trace also shows why enforcement must validate the authority, freshness, and claim-level relevance of evidence—not merely detect that some citation or tool activity exists.
